description:
Remove the background from an image

Cut the subject (person, product, animal, object) out of a photo and return it on a transparent background as png (default), webp or avif. Optional q (1-100) for webp/avif. Runs a segmentation model (U2Net) on CPU: expect a few seconds per image, not milliseconds. Not available in pipeline.

### Responses:

**200**: Processed image binary (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Type: image/jpeg

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```
Content-Type: image/png

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```
Content-Type: image/webp

**Example Response:**
```json
"string"
```

headers.description: Optional storage headers to include on the PUT call (Content-Type, Cache-Control, x-amz-acl, etc.). Whitelisted at SSRF layer.
headers.title: Headers

put_url.description: Customer-signed presigned PUT URL where the optimized bytes will be written. Must be https://. Cloud credentials never reach our infrastructure; only the URL itself is used and discarded after the request.
put_url.title: Put Url

callback_url.description: Customer endpoint where the optimized bytes will be POSTed. Must be https://. For async/large jobs. We send an X-Pig-Sha256 header of the body so the receiver can verify integrity. No credentials are stored on our side; secure the endpoint with a token in the URL itself.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

headers.description: Optional headers to include on the POST call (Content-Type, Cache-Control, x-amz-*, etc.). Whitelisted at SSRF layer.
headers.title: Headers

secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. When set, we sign the POST body with HMAC-SHA256 and send 'X-Pig-Signature: sha256=<hex>'. Used per request and never stored. Recompute the HMAC on your endpoint to authenticate the callback (constant-time compare).
secret.title: Secret

format.description: Output format: png (default), webp or avif. All three keep the transparency; jpeg is not offered because it has none.
format.title: format

q.description: Quality (1-100) for webp and avif. Ignored for png, which is lossless. Omit to use the encoder default.
q.title: q

source.description: Image source: a public URL (https://...) or a base64-encoded string (optionally as a data URI like data:image/png;base64,...).
source.title: source

name: remove_image_background
